Title: Highfield Therapy
Welcome: Welcome to Highfield Therapy. I offer warm, confidential, professional therapy to help you navigate life's challenges — online, or in person here in Sheffield.
About: My name is Robert, and my path into therapy grew out of eighteen years working in further education — first as a performing arts lecturer, then supporting students' wellbeing, progression and personal development across several colleges. It was through that work, and through volunteering as a listening Samaritan, with Cruse Bereavement, and with the Snowdrop Project as a trainee counsellor, that I found my real calling in walking alongside people through their most difficult experiences. Today I work in private practice as a counsellor and as a trainee psychotherapist in higher education. I hold professional diplomas in counselling and hypnotherapy, alongside extensive safeguarding and mental health first aid training. I believe that emotional wounds are formed in relationships and healed within one. My work is grounded in cultural humility — I see wellbeing as connected not only to the individual but also to family, community, and the wider world around us. I welcome all individuals, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation or background, by prioritising an affirming, non-judgemental space. Away from the therapy room, you'll usually find me running or out on the golf course.
Therapy: I work in an integrative, trauma-informed way, with a focus on Transactional Analysis (TA). Rather than following a single, rigid method, We can gently and safely tailor our work to your goals, so you feel grounded and in control. My study of Transactional Analysis helps us understand the relationship patterns you once learned to survive — patterns that may now affect trust, intimacy and self-worth. I offer both open-ended therapy and shorter, more focused work, online or in person from my private Garden Room in Sheffield, a calm space designed to feel like a secure retreat for the deeper work we do together.
Fees: Sessions are £50, and I offer concessions to those on a low or no income (State Benefits or Students). I can arrange a free 15-minute phone consultation to talk about how I can help and answer any questions you may have about therapy, then book an in-person or online appointment.
Contact: I'm based in Sheffield, a 20-minute walk from Sheffield Central station and close to a tram stop, with plenty of free on-street parking. To get in touch, call or message 07946827431, or use the email button below.
